description_en: Modifies the mapping configurations of an endpoint group that is associated with a custom routing listener
description_zh: 调用UpdateCustomRoutingEndpointGroupDestinations接口修改自定义路由类型监听所关联终端节点组的映射信息
name: UpdateCustomRoutingEndpointGroupDestinations

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among all requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the value of RequestId as the value of ClientToken. The value of RequestId for each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false: performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改终端节点组的映射信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接修改终端节点组的映射信息
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group
parameters.help_zh: 待修改映射信息的终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the mapping configuration of the endpoint group
fields.help_zh: 终端节点组的映射信息配置ID
fields.name: destination_id

fields.help_en:
The start port of the backend service port range of the endpoint group.

Valid values: 1 to 65499. The FromPort value must be smaller than or equal to the ToPort value.

You can specify up to 20 start ports in each request
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组后端服务起始端口。

取值范围：1~65499，且需满足FromPort≤ToPort，即终端节点组后端服务起始端口需小于等于终端节点组后端服务结束端口。

单次调用本接口最多可输入20条后端服务起始端口信息
fields.name: from_port

fields.help_en:
The backend service protocol of the endpoint group. Valid values:

tcp: TCP
udp: UDP
tcp,udp: TCP and UDP

You can specify up to four backend service protocols in each configuration
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组后端服务协议类型。取值：

TCP：TCP协议。

UDP：UDP协议。

TCP,UDP：TCP和UDP协议。


每个终端节点组映射端口范围和协议类型信息中，最多可以输入4个后端服务协议类型
fields.name: protocols

fields.help_en:
The end port of the backend service port range of the endpoint group.

Valid values: 1 to 65499. The FromPort value must be smaller than or equal to the ToPort value.

You can specify up to 20 end ports in each request
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组后端服务结束端口。

取值范围：1~65499，且需满足FromPort≤ToPort，即终端节点组后端服务起始端口需小于等于终端节点组后端服务结束端口。

单次调用本接口最多可输入20条后端服务结束端口信息
fields.name: to_port

parameters.help_en:
The mapping configurations of endpoint group.

You must specify the backend service port range and protocol of the endpoint group. The specified information is used to map the port range of the associated listener.

You can specify at most 20 mapping configurations, which include port ranges and protocol types
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组的映射信息配置。

您需要输入终端节点组后端服务端口范围和协议类型，输入信息与关联的监听端口范围将形成映射关系。

单次调用本接口最多可输入20个映射端口范围和协议类型信息
parameters.name: destination_configurations
